articles.summary: The US Dollar (USD) remained well on the defensive on Wednesday, receding to levels last seen in late October amid mounting bets for another interest rate cut by the Federal Reserve at its meeting next week.
articles.title: FX Today: Attention shifts to the US employment data

articles.author: Ghiles Guezout
articles.summary: AUD/USD trades firmly on Wednesday, around 0.6590 at the time of writing, up 0.50% on the day.
articles.title: AUD/USD gains as US Dollar falters on Fed Chair speculation, RBA hawkish tone

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: Gold price declines some 0.20% on Wednesday as US economic data, although mixed, reaffirmes traders’ expectations for a rate cut next week at the Fed's meeting. XAU/USD trades above $4,200 after bouncing off daily highss of $4,240.
articles.title: Gold floats around $4,200 amid US Dollar slide and growing Fed-pivot bets

articles.author: Joshua Gibson
articles.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) rose 420 points on Wednesday, sparked by renewed market optimism that the US economy is performing so poorly that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will be forced to deliver a third straight interest rate cut in December.
articles.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average gains 420 points as rate cut hopes climb

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: EUR/USD surges over 0.40% on Wednesday after economic data in the US reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve would cut rates at the December 9-10 meeting. The pair trades at 1.1668 after bouncing off daily lows of 1.1617.
articles.title: EUR/USD strengthens as weak US labor data pushes cut odds to 90%

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: Silver price retreats late in the North American session on Wednesday even though the US Dollar weakens after data reaffirmed investors intentions that the Federal Reserve would cut rates next week. At the time of writing, XAG/USD trades at $58.49 down 0.14%.
articles.title: Silver Price Analysis: Uptrend holds as RSI divergence signals corrective risks

articles.author: Lallalit Srijandorn
articles.summary: Australia’s Trade Surplus widened to 4,385M MoM in October versus 3,707M (revised from 3,938M) in the previous reading, according to the latest foreign trade data published by the Australian Bureau of Statistics on Thursday.
articles.title: Australia’s Trade Surplus widens to 4,385M MoM in October

articles.author: Lallalit Srijandorn
articles.summary: The USD/JPY pair attracts some sellers to around 155.25 during the early Asian session on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on weaker-than-expected US jobs data and expectations of further US rate cuts.
articles.title: USD/JPY declines below 155.50 on weaker US jobs data, rising BoJ rate hike expectations
